topics.title: Elvis and Hamburger James's Airport Confrontation
topics.summary: During a chaotic scene at Las Vegas in 1974, a stolen Elvis attempts to control air traffic while confronting a drug-addicted former associate named Hamburger James. The situation escalates with emotional outbursts, accusations of theft, culminating in an impromptu slap and subsequent weeping from both men.

topics.title: Helmsley's Insults & Milwaukee Incident
topics.summary: Mrs. Helmsley unleashes a barrage of offensive remarks against Barbara Walters and others, including bizarre comments about plastic surgery plans. The broadcast then shifts to report on the arrest of a 15-year-old boy named Louis Polonia in Milwaukee after an incident involving a baseball player.

topics.title: Gunsmoke and Shocking Crimes
topics.summary: The broadcast discusses recent criminal investigations including Harold Hoshkiss, charged with multiple counts of sexual assault against children involving shocking acts like using a car battery for shock therapy and photographing explicit encounters for sale; alongside the arrest of a Stanford man whose bra contained over 125 vials of crack cocaine.

topics.title: Police Strip Search, Phone Line Chaos
topics.summary: During a police investigation following an arrest, the host discusses a strip search conducted on the individual and then transitions to a chaotic phone segment involving callers discussing Curtis Rock’s case and allegations against Celeste, a striking telephone worker. The conversation shifts to casting opportunities for Howard Stern in a movie role.

topics.title: Backstage Conversation and Guest Encounters
topics.summary: During backstage chatter, the hosts discuss an upcoming concert featuring Lenny Clark as a guest alongside family members assisting with screen setup. Unexpected encounters include Cher and her son Elijah Blue, followed by Taylor Dane who was reportedly kicked out by Howie Mandel for confronting him.

topics.title: Radio Host Discusses Movie Production & Personal Anecdotes
topics.summary: During the broadcast, the host discusses movie production details with Rick Rubin and Stallone’s trainer, including filming on Capitol Records building and potential nudity involving female crew members. He then shifts to personal anecdotes about his wife's wardrobe choices and attempts at impressing her while discussing sexual encounters.
